title: ZOMBIEPOWDER.
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a desert world, Gamma Akutabi, a man with a metal arm and a huge chainsaw sword, hunts the 12 Rings of the Dead, the only source of Zombie Powder, which can raise the dead and grant eternal life. He gathers a team of gunman C.T. Smith, knife-throwing teenager Elwood and journalist Wolfgangina against crooks, killers and superpowered villains. Tite Kubo's early Western-style action series, cancelled after four volumes.
life_message: Loyal companions facing danger together matter more than the lure of eternal life.
